title: Introduce quiet-merge signal and lint telemetry adapter
author: Ava Chen
description: Context: our presubmit lanes produce noisy merge traffic and noisy alerting for non-actionable lint regressions. This PR introduces two complementary pieces: 1) a lightweight 'quiet-merge' signal that lets the merge service suppress non-critical notifications and avoid triggering heavyweight post-merge jobs on low-risk infra/docs-only changes; and 2) a lint telemetry adapter that collects anonymized lint rule violation counts and time-to-fix metrics for presubmit failures so we can prioritize rule maintenance and reduce flakiness. Motivation: reduce pager noise and CI cost from churny lint failures, enable data-driven lint rule triage, and create a simple opt-in signal for release automation to skip non-essential post-merge jobs. Work included: - new CI input flag and API hook consumed by merge-orchestrator - presubmit hook that annotates PR metadata with quiet-merge eligibility reasons - telemetry adapter that emits compact counters to ci-telemetry (rule_id, severity, presubmit_stage) - docs and SDK shim for internal tooling to opt into quiet merges Checklist: - [x] implement quiet-merge signal and merge-orchestrator support - [x] add lint telemetry adapter and batching exporter - [x] unit tests for hook and adapter - [x] integration test in staging CI lane - [x] docs (console+infra runbook) - [x] add Linear links and update monitoring runbook Commits (summary): 1) add quiet-merge input and merge-orchestrator flag (3 commits) 2) implement presubmit hook and eligibility evaluator (2 commits) 3) add lint-telemetry adapter + batching exporter (2 commits) 4) tests and mocks (3 commits) 5) docs, runbook, changelog (1 commit) Changed areas (high-level): - ci/merge-orchestrator/src/main.rs: add quiet_merge handling and eval gate - ci/presubmit-hooks/lint_eligibility.py: new eligibility evaluator used by presubmit - infra/ci-templates/merge-job.yaml: conditional skip when quiet_merge=true - infra/telemetry/telemetry-adapters/lint_adapter.go: collects per-rule counters and ships batched events - sdk/internal/ci/README.md: usage and opt-in instructions - tests/integration/quiet_merge_end_to_end_test.sh: staging smoke test Illustrative diffs (small snippets):
commits_summary: 7 commits total; major logical pieces: quiet-merge inputs and evaluations (3), lint telemetry adapter w/ batching (2), tests/docs (2)
diff_snippets: if metadata.quiet_merge { notify = false; run_post_merge_jobs = run_post_merge_jobs.filter(|j| j.critical); }
def is_quiet_merge(pr): if pr.files_changed_only_in(['docs/', 'infra/']): return True
func (a *Adapter) Emit(rule string, severity string) { a.batch = append(a.batch, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s", rule, severity)); if len(a.batch) >= a.batchSize { a.flush() } }
